M03 uses M02 network.Source: SVB-57 (D2) ADR-103 flag, default off: off keeps M03 on the 16-node fallback graph (logs and seeded hashes unchanged). On, M03 installs the real M02 depositor network (public/group/professional CSR layers, M02 node credibility) on its first step; every real-mode log and real-M03 hash changes. CPU engine only (refused under GPU calibration).
